name: Thaumaturgy (Neptune's Might) — Basic — Prison of Water

system.description: You animate a sufficient body of water to imprison a subject, spending Blood Traits to invest the prison with two Physical Traits each (plus your Occult rating). The subject must win a Physical Test against the prison's Traits to break free; you may instead crush the subject, inflicting one health level of lethal damage per successful challenge, or automatically drown a mortal. You must maintain line of sight to both the water source and the subject to sustain the effect.
system.duration: As long as line of sight is maintained
